# Command reference

<!-- Generated by `just docs-commands` (tools/gendocs). Do not edit by hand. -->

Every MCP tool corresponds to one Juju 3.6 CLI command and carries the same name. This page lists all 151 tools with their [MCP tool annotations](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/tools#tool-annotations) and their availability in [read-only mode](read-only-mode.md). Tools are listed in the order the Juju CLI registers them, which is also the order returned by `tools/list`.

Column meanings:

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Read-only | `readOnlyHint`: the tool does not modify Juju state or the host |
| Destructive | `destructiveHint`: the tool removes or replaces state, or upgrades software |
| Idempotent | `idempotentHint`: repeating the call with the same arguments has no additional effect |
| Open world | `openWorldHint`: the tool contacts a service other than the Juju controller (Charmhub, an arbitrary host, a URL) |
| In read-only mode | `yes`: registered as is; `no`: not registered; `policy`: registered, calls accepted only in the described shape |

## Commands not exposed

These Juju 3.6 CLI commands are not available as tools because their constructors are unexported in `github.com/juju/juju/cmd/juju/commands`:

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `bootstrap` | Initialise a cloud environment |
| `debug-log` | Display the log for a model |
| `enable-ha` | Ensure that sufficient controllers exist to provide redundancy |
| `help-action-commands` | Show help on a Juju charm action command |
| `help-hook-commands` | Show help on a Juju charm hook command |
| `migrate` | Migrate a model to another controller |
| `switch` | Select or identify the current controller and model |
| `sync-agent-binary` | Copy agent binaries from the official agent store into a local controller |
| `upgrade-controller` | Upgrade the Juju agent for a controller |
| `upgrade-model` | Upgrade the Juju agent for a model |
| `version` | Print the Juju CLI client version |

Aliases of the Juju CLI (for example `list-models` for `models`, `relate` for `integrate`, `add-relation` for `integrate`) are not registered; only the canonical name is a tool.
